title: Fix off-by-one and boundary errors in pagination
prompt: src/pagination.py has several defects users hit at the edges: the last page sometimes omits an item, requesting a page past the end raises instead of returning an empty page, total_pages is wrong when the item count divides evenly, and an empty collection reports one page of nothing but claims zero. Fix paginate() so that pages are 1-indexed, each page holds at most per_page items, the last page holds the remainder, a page beyond the end yields an empty item list with has_next False, an empty collection reports total_pages 1 and total_items 0, and page or per_page below 1 raises ValueError. Keep the returned structure and the function signature exactly as they are.
acceptance_criteria: Pages are 1-indexed and each holds at most per_page items.
The last page contains the remainder, with nothing dropped.
total_pages is correct when the count divides evenly and when it does not.
A page past the end returns an empty list, has_next False and has_prev True.
An empty collection reports total_pages 1, total_items 0 and an empty page.
The returned dictionary keys and the function signature are unchanged.
